result.reason: Both levels fail because the operative conformance warranties are qualified by “in all material respects,” while neither stated position permits immaterial nonconformities. The durations, remedies, workmanlike-performance warranty, legal-compliance warranty, and malicious-code warranty otherwise meet or exceed both positions. The express-warranty carveout preserves the new warranties despite the broad disclaimer and introduces no contradiction. The redline is not minimal because it adds protections beyond the stated requirements—such as an industry-standards benchmark and separate virus/disabling-device warranties—and still does not fully reach either level. Drafting is also weakened by the phrase “refund of fees paid or payable,” since unpaid fees cannot literally be refunded.
